description: NextGen is NOAA's C++ engine for composing hydrological models around catchments and their flow connections. It separates spatial data and model formulations, allowing different model components or nested representations within a common catchment network. Inputs include catchment and nexus GeoJSON, a JSON realisation configuration and optional partition settings; outputs are the water-flow and state results of the selected formulations. Geographic coverage, time step and spatial detail depend on the hydrofabric and component models. Public source and build instructions are free under Apache-2.0. A limitation is that the README describes the architecture as a prototype, and an engine configuration does not establish calibration or validity of the hydrological components. Dependencies and distributed execution require explicit setup. NextGen can support alternative hydrologic representations for water-infrastructure simulations, related to the National Water Model (model-noaa-national-water-model). The repository documents full and subset runs and configuration checks. No hydrofabric, model archive or executable was downloaded.
